title: The Shadow of What Was Lost
author: James Islington
summary: First of a fantasy trilogy. Decades after a war that destroyed those with magic, a few young people still show signs of power and must hide it while a quiet, dangerous conspiracy gathers in the background.
readIf: you like long, slow-building epic fantasy with hidden mysteries and a magic system to piece together.
skipIf: you want fast action, as the early chapters take their time and set up a great deal.

pairings.reason: Another long, immersive fantasy about a gifted young person learning the rules of a hidden power.
A comparable traditional epic where a group of young people are drawn toward an ancient struggle.
A faster, tighter epic with a similar fascination for hidden powers and a good twist.
